description: Mystic threats, Daredevil, the Goblins, Venom and Carnage pull Spider-Man into increasingly personal conflicts while Mary Jane's fate becomes inseparable from the dimensional technology surrounding his enemies.

s03e01.description: Mary Jane is drawn into Baron Mordo's cult, leading Spider-Man to Doctor Strange and a battle to keep Dormammu out of Earth's dimension.

s03e02.description: After a destructive battle makes Peter question being Spider-Man, a young fan and Madame Web force him to reconsider what the mask means.

s03e03.description: A head injury leaves Spider-Man with amnesia, allowing Doctor Octopus to convince him that they are partners in crime.

s03e04.description: The Green Goblin appears with intimate knowledge of Oscorp's secrets, targeting Norman Osborn and everyone tied to his hidden dealings.

s03e05.description: Spider-Man investigates a high-speed thief using advanced rocket technology and discovers a young man trapped between crime and family responsibility.

s03e06.description: Peter is framed for stealing government secrets, bringing Matt Murdock into the case and exposing a conspiracy tied to the Kingpin.

s03e07.description: Spider-Man and Daredevil join forces against the Kingpin while Peter learns more about the crime lord's connection to his recent troubles.

s03e08.description: Alistair Smythe is transformed into the Ultimate Spider-Slayer and sent after Spider-Man as the Kingpin tightens control over his reluctant servant.

s03e09.description: Robbie Robertson's troubled history with Tombstone resurfaces when the nearly invulnerable criminal threatens both Robbie and his son.

s03e10.description: Venom returns when Dormammu and Baron Mordo exploit the symbiote, forcing Spider-Man to confront Eddie Brock under even darker influence.

s03e11.description: The Carnage symbiote bonds with Cletus Kasady and begins feeding Dormammu's plan, pushing Spider-Man into an uneasy alliance with Venom.

s03e12.description: A scientist creates portals through space and becomes the Spot, but the Kingpin turns his breakthrough into leverage for a criminal scheme.

s03e13.description: Green Goblin and Hobgoblin wage war over a dimensional device, trapping Spider-Man between two enemies with very different ambitions.

s03e14.description: The Green Goblin targets Mary Jane and forces Spider-Man into a confrontation whose consequences change Peter's life dramatically.
